name: Claire
source:
A greenhorn adventurer. She has recently attained the rank of "rookie" in the adventurer's guild after working her way up through countless simple assignments such as package delivery and armed escort. Upon her promotion, she is offered the quest to clear a goblin-infested dungeon which has terrorised villages.

She looks up to senior adventurers Mavis and Jessica.
